notes.title: Update v1.03
notes.content:
[h3]Update v1.03[/h3]

[h2]Improving[/h2]
[list]
[*] Text now appears below UI elements that were previously blocking it.
[*] Dodge effects are no longer cleared at the end of a round.
[*] All decks in the upper right corner return to the deck after battle ends.
[*] Monster spawn speed remains constant during acceleration(Pressing Space).
[*] Optimized the appearance of effect text after battle ends.
[*] Adjusted the positions of characters and monsters (shifted left).
[/list]

[h2]Balance Change[/h2]
[list]
[*]【Revival】When Hp rises above 50%,Gain 6 Strength → 12 Strength
[*]【Ritual of Invocation】On Block increases to 20 points,Gain 5 Block → 10 Block
[*]【Divine Blessing】On Block increases to 30 points,Gain 5 Block → 15 Block
[*]【Spirit Of Shield】When Hp drops below 50%,Gain 8 Block → 16 Block
[*]【Elf's blessing】When Hp rises above 50%,Heal 4 Hp → 8 Hp
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing the game to freeze when entering the card shop.
[/list]

Don't forget to [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Join our Discord[/url] if you have feedback or questions about the game.

notes.title: Slay the Abyss - Deck Builders Fest & Demo Update v03.2.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we're thrilled that Slay the Abyss is participating in the Steam Deck Builders Fest! To celebrate this event, the demo has been updated to version 0.3.24, including art improving, bug fixes, and balance changes. 

Here's what's new in the update:

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Corrected the issue that English descriptions didn't match.
[*] Fixed the bug where the game would freeze on the event selection screen upon first entry.
[*] Fixed a bug that the tutorial couldn't be repeated.
[*] Corrected the issue where "Metalization" wasn't effective.
[/olist]

[h2]Improving[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Implemented new artwork and UI.
[*] Revamped the tutorial.
[*] The spacebar can now accelerate gamespeed.
[/olist]

[h2]Balance Change[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Increased monster speed.
[*] Enhanced the rarity of loot cards.
[*] Adjusted the combat system. Character will attack at the end of their turn now.
[/olist]

Don't forget to [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Join our Discord[/url] if you have feedback or questions about the game.

Fixed a bug that the tutorial couldn't be repeated.
Corrected the issue where "Metalization" wasn't effective.

Revamped the tutorial.

notes.title: Slay the Abyss Demo Update v0.3.22
notes.content:
Hi there. Slay the Abyss demo has now been updated to v0.3.22:

[h2] Improving [/h2]
[list]
[*]Now, when there are cards in the deck and the hand is not full, cards will be drawn automatically.
[*]Improved the display of attack indicators on enemies.
[*]Improved the hit effect.
[*]Slay effect will now be cleared after the execution, rather than after an attack.
[*]Adjusted the font of the cards.
[*]Unified the Quit/Back button to a bottom-right arrow.
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Enemies’ positions will change with the attack order, with the first one always being the first to attack.
[*]Added time display to the selection interface.
[*]Added automatically used Cards; now, "Poison" is the automatically used card.
[*]Long-pressing the space bar can speed up the game.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug that adjusting the game music during battle had no effect.
[*]Fixed the bug that Slay effect did not work properly.
[/list]

Don't forget to [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Join our Discord[/url] if you have feedback or questions about the game.
